test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

25 ÷ 5 – 918 × 9 + 4 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e91cc72ba598cfdbee8d6aaaefeee23c52fe62c8aaf27914d98f03ca1d06dc9f.png] 

Given equation: 25 ÷ 5 – 918 × 9 + 4 = ?

if ‘+’ and ‘–’ and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged then we get:

⇒ 25 × 5 + 918 ÷
